sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the sentiment score reflects market expectations rather than guidance changes. The document describes a stock that has already rallied 16% year-to-date heading into the report, with options markets pricing a swing of roughly 5.08% (above the four-quarter average of 4.1%), and analyst estimates revised down 2.9% over the trailing 30 days. This combination of an elevated stock price and a modest downward revision to estimates suggests a somewhat stretched bar, increasing the risk of a negative surprise even on decent results, warranting a mildly bearish score.
